rationale: Raw reads recovered exactly from the deposited normalized table, which is reads scaled to 20 million per library plus a pseudocount of 1 ((x - 1) / s is an integer for every guide). The paper ran MAGeCK on day 21 of HRAS(G12V) induction versus day 0 in two independent BJ-dCas9-KRAB clones (a, b); each clone has its own D0 and D21, so the clone term pairs them. 4 libraries, 1 residual df.
